title: Object Storage: minimum invoice amount
content:
Object Storage minimum invoice amount is defined as follows: Minimum positive monthly invoice total; USD decimal, smaller totals carry forward.

| Contract tier | Minimum invoice amount |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | minimum invoice amount: 0.5 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | minimum invoice amount: 0.5 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | minimum invoice amount: 0.5 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | minimum invoice amount: 0.5 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | minimum invoice amount: 0.5 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | minimum invoice amount: 0.5 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the minimum invoice amount entry is 0.5.
